I reached the Sales app (Quotations list → New), set the customer to 'fwod37-n2 Bench Customer' by picking that option from the customer autocomplete dropdown, and added exactly ONE order line with the product 'Customizable Desk' chosen from the product autocomplete dropdown at quantity 3. The app auto-filled the unit price as £ 750.00 (the price came from the product configurator, which opened because the product is configurable; I confirmed the default variant [FURN_0096] Customizable Desk (Steel, White) at £ 750.00 with qty 3), and the totals area shows Untaxed Amount £ 2,250.00, TAX 20% £ 450.00, Total £ 2,700.00. However, I could NOT confirm the quotation was saved: an earlier Save attempt was blocked by a leftover product-configurator modal overlay, cancelling that modal removed the first order line, and after re-adding the line the form title still read 'New' (URL model=sale.order&view_type=form with no record id). The quotation's name/reference is therefore NOT verified — it may still be unsaved.
